message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and `npm test` shows 18 of 18 passing. The fix is in `src/payments/receipt.js`, the only file I changed.

**Root cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divides by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 was rendered as ¥5.00. The receipt test was failing because of this.

**Why the fix is in `receipt.js`:** A Fenceline rule says this task only touches `src/payments`, and it blocked my edit to `money.js`. I didn't work around that. Instead, `renderReceipt` now formats JPY amounts as whole yen, and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney` unchanged.

**What's still broken:** `money.js` has the same bug, so invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) will still show yen wrong. The proper fix is the zero-decimal handling in `formatMoney`, which is a 3-line change to `money.js`. To apply it, you'd need to lift or extend the fence on `src/utils/money.js` for this task. Tell me if you want that, and I'll make the change and move the receipt back onto the shared helper.

I haven't committed anything.
